title: Generation of a Three-dimensional Full Thickness Skin Equivalent and Automated Wounding
protocol: Dissolve collagen with 0.1% acetic acid to a final concentration of 6 mg/ml.
Mix 232.5 ml 2x DMEM, 7.5 ml fetal calf serum, 7.5 ml 3 M HEPES, and 2.5 ml chondroitin sulfate (5 mg/ml) for the gel neutralization solution.
Keep the gel neutralization solution and collagen solution on ice.
Place 24 inserts into a 24 well plate.
Resuspend human dermal fibroblasts in 10 ml DMEM, centrifuge for 5 min at 270 x g, and count the cells.
Extract the required amount of hDF (5 x 10^4 cells per 500 μl collagen gel) and centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 270 x g.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend hDF in 4 ml cooled gel neutralization solution without producing air bubbles.
Resuspend the solution with 8 ml of collagen solution.
Take the collagen-cell-mixture with a multistep-pipette.
Fill quickly 500 μl of mixture in each insert.
Incubate the gels for 20 min in an incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2) to jell the gels.
Submerge the gels in 2 ml Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) + 10% fetal calf serum (FCS) per well.
Incubate for 24 hr in an incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Remove medium after 24 hr.
Dissolve fibronectin human protein with ultrapure water to a final concentration of 50 μg/ml.
Cover each dermal equivalent with 25 μl of fibronectin solution.
Incubate the gels for 30 min in an incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Resuspend the hEK in 10 ml KGM-2 and set cell concentration to 1 x 10^6 cells/ml with KGM-2 ready + 5% FCS.
Seed 1 x 10^5 hEK on each gel.
Incubate gels for 45 min in the incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2) to allow cells to adhere.
Submerse the gels with KGM-2 ready + 5% FCS and culture them in the incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Culture ftSE for 6-7 days in descending FCS-concentration (5%, 2%, and 0% FCS).
Change the medium every 2-3 days with the next lower FCS concentration.
On day 7, remove medium completely without touching the ftSE surface.
Place every insert into 1 well of a 6 well plate using sterile forceps.
Add 1.5 ml airlift medium per well, ensuring not to wet the ftSE surface.
Change the medium every 2-3 days for an additional 14 days.
Remove the culture medium from the inserts.
Transfer the inserts to fresh 24 well plates.
Fix tissues by adding 1.6 ml of 4% paraformaldehyde to each well and incubate at room temperature for 2 hours.
Transfer the ftSE to a tissue-embedding cassette.
Wash the tissue with water to remove remaining fixative.
Dehydrate the tissue using ascending ethanol concentrations.
Divide the skin equivalent by making a vertical cut in the middle.
Place the two pieces in a paraffin-filled metal base mold with cut surfaces downwards.
Add the tissue cassette on top of the mold as a backing.
Cut 3-5 µm slices and float them on a 40 °C water bath for straightening.
Mount the slides onto suitable microscope slides.
Dry the slices thoroughly.
Place the slides into a rack and incubate at 60 °C for 1 hour to ensure paraffin is melted.
Stain rehydrated slices with H&E as a standardized overview staining.
Prepare 4x glass staining cuvettes with xylol for H&E staining.
Place slides in xylol I for 10 min to deparaffinize and rehydrate.
Place slides in xylol II for 10 min to continue deparaffinization and rehydration.
Dip slides in ethanol 96% I three times.
Dip slides in ethanol 96% II three times.
Dip slides in ethanol 70% three times.
Dip slides in ethanol 50% three times.
Rotate slides in deionized water.
Dip slides twice in HCl-ethanol to differentiate hematoxylin dye.
Rinse slides in deionized water.
Place slides in tab water for 5 min for blueing.
Place slides in eosin for 1 min for staining.
Wash slides in deionized water after eosin staining.
Dip slides twice in ethanol 70% for dehydration.
Dip slides twice in ethanol 96% for further dehydration.
Place slides in 2-propanol I for 5 min for final dehydration.
Place slides in 2-propanol II for 5 min to continue final dehydration.
Place slides in xylol I for 5 min as the last step of dehydration.
Place slides in xylol II for 5 min to complete dehydration.
Place slides in a moisture chamber.
Block endogenous peroxidase by adding 100 μl of 3% hydrogen peroxide solution onto each slice.
Wash slides in washing buffer.
Apply primary antibody and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash slides three times with washing buffer.
Counterstain nuclei with Hematoxylin for 1 minute.
Dehydrate and mount slides.
Image samples using an inverse microscope.
Disinfect the working area with 70% ethanol and ultraviolet light.
Attach the drilling head of the desired size to the aWD.
Place skin equivalents into designated areas of the autoclaved sample carrier plate using sterile forceps.
Place the sample carrier plate into the socket below the drilling head.
Set wounding parameters in the control software: spin velocity at 15,000 rpm; penetration at 1.5 mm; propulsion at 100 Hz.
Transfer wounding parameters to the aWD.
Start the wounding procedure.
Remove the sample carrier plate from the socket.
Transfer wounded ftSE back into inserts used for culture using sterile forceps.
Culture wounded ftSE in the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for investigation of regeneration.
Use the models for histological analysis at any time.
